title: Audex Backup and Recovery Drill Runbook
author: Mohamed Alseify
objective: Write and execute a sandbox backup/restore drill for configuration and database packages.

steps.action: Identify critical system configuration and data paths.
steps.command_or_method: Verify existence of audex_config.json and data directories.

steps.action: Create a compressed archive with a unique timestamp.
Simulate data loss by removing or modifying the active configuration file.
Restore the latest backup archive into the active working directory.
Validate that the restored file matches the original hash and system is operational.
